title: Vatican Museums €25. The Forbidden City in Winter: ¥40 | China Travel Expert
description:
China Price Check: two of the world's great palaces, two very different ticket prices.

The Vatican Museums (which include the Sistine Chapel) cost €20 for a standard adult ticket, plus a compulsory €5 online booking fee = €25 online, about $29.

The Forbidden City in Beijing switches to its winter / low-season price from today, 1 November: ¥40 (it is ¥60 in peak season, 1 Apr–31 Oct). ¥40 is about $6 — so the Vatican Museums cost nearly five times as much as a Forbidden City ticket this month.

Both are booked online with ID/passport. Prices verified on publish day; currency conversions use early-November 2026 rates and will drift.

🧭 Expert Tip: Forbidden City tickets are released 7 days ahead at 20:00 Beijing time and sell out fast — book early and bring the passport you booked with. No same-day tickets at the gate.
